notes.title: Unlife will be released on 07/06/2022
notes.notes:
As i promised several days ago i am very glad to announce the Unlife release date! It will be released  already in next week - on [b]7 of June 2022![/b]
The 5 years of single game developing are finished! Thank you for waiting. Lets meet in the world of Unlife next week!

notes.title: Unlife is live and coming soon!
notes.notes:
In the constant moving flow of life which full of different events and work it is very difficult to know, how much time you need to finish the game, especially if you develop it by their own.

But i have some good news for you :

1) The game is almost done, but i need to do some tests. I planning to release it soon and i tell about release date as soon as possible.

2) At the release it will also available Unlife DLC which contains full original soundtrack with 15 instrumental compositions

3) It were long five years with hot and cold periods of developing, but i glad that now im really on the finish line.

Thank you, for waiting!
